related_resources.reason: Marine-reservoir corrected chronology places North Island settlement c. 1250–1275 and South Island c. 1280–1295, with later subsistence transitions. Site-date models are not exact dates for each ancestor story.
Review of 1,434 dates emphasizes short-lived samples; proposed late eastern-Polynesian chronology is an evidence-driven model, not a log of named voyages.
Excavation history, village/cooking/tool contexts and 2009 research invited by Rangitāne o Wairau after ancestral repatriation; source does not represent all Māori views.
Records the prolonged requests for return of Māori ancestors and Rangitāne objections to Wairau Bar removals; a twentieth-century archaeological ethical history.
Supplementary orientation; no historical claim rests solely on this source.
